description:
Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O, Jason "Wee man" Acuña, Sean "Poopies" McInerney, Preston Lacy, Zach Holmes, Jasper Dolphin, Compston "Dark Shark" Wilson, Ehren McGhehey, Rachel Wolfson, Dave England, and director/producer Jeff Tremaine chat with Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Mark Ellis at the "Block Party" for 'Jackass: Best and Last'!  They share their favorite stunts, memorable moments, and what fans can expect from their grand finale film.  See 'Jackass: Best and Last' in theaters June 26!
